description: Defines which data fields the BattleArena combat system must provide for each screen. Only field presence and correctness matter — placement and formatting are left to the UI implementation.

characterCard.description: Character status card shown throughout combat for each combatant. All cards MUST be the same height regardless of class or alive/dead status — non-spellcasters render a dimmed placeholder MP row so all cards remain aligned.

layout.description: Visual row structure of the character card. Each row is composed of segments that display specific data. Non-spellcasters (MaxMana = 0) render a dimmed placeholder for the mana row to keep card height uniform.

rows.description: Turn meter progress bar and numeric value
Mana bar and current/max values. Non-casters render a dimmed placeholder row.

requiredFields.description: Character display name
Character level (1–20)
Character class name (e.g. Barbarian, Mage)
Character sex (M/F/X)
Character race name (e.g. Human, Orc, Elf)
Current hit points (can be negative after KO)
Maximum hit points — must be > 0
Current mana points. Non-casters render a dimmed placeholder so card height stays uniform.
Maximum mana points. Non-casters (MaxMana = 0) render a dimmed placeholder row.
Mana regenerated each tick. Derived from Intelligence, level, equipped gear bonuses and regenerative spells.
Turn meter value (0–100), tracked via TurnMeterGain / TurnEnd events
Weapon currently held in the right hand
Active attack source used this turn (weapon or spell name), updated on TurnStart events
List of spells the character has memorized. Each entry has: Name, School, DamageCount, DamageDie, DamageType, ManaCost, SpellLevel. Only present when Character.MemorizedSpells.Count > 0.
Alive/dead flag derivable from CurrentHitPoints

roundBar.description: Progress bar shown at the top of the combat screen during combat. A round is a fixed number of ticks (RoundLength = 10). The bar fills as ticks advance within the round and resets at each RoundStart.

requiredFields.description: Current round number, starting at 1. Updated on RoundStart and RoundEnd events.
Absolute tick counter. Position within round = ((Tick - 1) % RoundLength) + 1, range 1–10.
Fixed at 10. RoundStart fires at tick 1, 11, 21 … RoundEnd fires at tick 10, 20, 30 …
0.0–1.0 fill fraction for the round bar. Formula: ((Tick-1) % 10 + 1) / 10.0

attackEvent.description: Displayed each time a character makes an attack (CombatLogEntry with EventType = Attack). Shows attacker, target, attack source, die roll, severity label, and damage.

requiredFields.description: Name of the attacking character
Name of the defending character
Weapon or spell used for the attack
d20 roll result
Attacker's total combat power
Defender's total defense power
Whether the attack connected
Critical hit flag
Fumble flag
Damage dealt — required to be > 0 on a hit, null/absent on a miss

manaEvent.description: Tracks mana changes during combat. Two event types: ManaDeduct (spell cast) and ManaRegen (end-of-round regeneration). Only relevant for spellcasters (MaxMana > 0).

requiredFields.description: Spellcaster whose mana changed
Mana spent on this cast (ManaDeduct event). Null on ManaRegen events.
Mana pool after the change. Use this to update the MP bar.
Amount regenerated this tick (ManaRegen event). Derived from Character.ManaRegenPerTick.

damageEvent.description: Displayed when a character takes HP damage (CombatLogEntry with EventType = Damage)

requiredFields.description: Name of the character taking damage
HP lost in this event
HP before taking damage
HP after taking damage

hotTick.description: Displayed each tick a heal-over-time effect restores HP (CombatLogEntry with EventType = HoTTick). ActorName is the character being healed.

requiredFields.description: Name of the character being healed
HP restored this tick (stored in DamageDealt field)
HP before the HoT tick
HP after the HoT tick (capped at MaxHp)
Name of the HoT status effect

healedEvent.description: Displayed when a healing spell restores HP to a target (CombatLogEntry with EventType = Healed). ActorName is the character being healed.

requiredFields.description: Name of the character being healed
HP restored by the spell (stored in DamageDealt field)
HP before the heal
HP after the heal (capped at MaxHp)
Name of the healing spell used

combatSummary.description: End-of-combat results data produced by the combat engine.

requiredFields.description: Unique GUID identifying this combat run
Total ticks the combat lasted
Winning party name
Losing party name
Dead (HP ≤ -10) or KnockedOut (HP 0 to -9)

hitLabels.description: Graded hit severity labels shown in attack events. Label is computed by CombatHitLabelService.GetLabel(damage, targetMaxHp) as damage / targetMaxHp percentage.
